name: AdvancedMD
description: AdvancedMD is a cloud platform for independent healthcare practices that combines electronic health records, practice management, patient engagement, medical billing, and revenue-cycle workflows. Practices use it to manage schedules, clinical documentation, patients, claims, payments, communications, reporting, and day-to-day care operations.
agentUseSummary: AdvancedMD is visible as a developer-review preview only. Relay will not collect an AdvancedMD login, office key, appname, token, patient portal credential, patient identifier, clinical record, insurance detail, payment detail, or other credential, and no agent action is callable until AdvancedMD and Relay's healthcare owners approve the exact bounded read-only SMART-on-FHIR contract.

capabilities.label: Read approved AdvancedMD clinical summaries
capabilities.description: After AdvancedMD and Relay's healthcare owners approve the integration, read only bounded patient- or provider-authorized FHIR summaries for one exact practice, limited to the explicitly approved clinical resources and fields.

blocked.label: Connect before developer approval
blocked.description: AdvancedMD requires a signed Certified API Developer Agreement, licensing and support fees, sandbox testing, an integration demonstration, and production credentials for Connect APIs. Relay has none of those approvals or a registered SMART-on-FHIR production application.

blocked.label: Collect clinical or application credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask for an AdvancedMD login, office key, appname, token, patient portal credential, patient identifier, clinical record, insurance detail, payment detail, or other secret as a substitute for approved SMART authorization.

blocked.label: Run AdvancedMD API actions
blocked.description: No patient, appointment, chart, medication, allergy, vital, order, result, billing, claim, payment, message, report, or other AdvancedMD API action can run while developer and healthcare review is pending.

blocked.label: Clinical and financial mutations unavailable
blocked.description: Proprietary Connect API CRUD, chart changes, scheduling, prescriptions, orders, billing, claims, payments, communications, bulk exports, raw PHI, and every mutation remain outside Relay's planned read-only V1 even after approval.

approvalProfiles.label: AdvancedMD developer review pending
approvalProfiles.description: Clinical reads remain unavailable until the developer agreement, paid license, sandbox demonstration, production registration, SMART authorization, privacy, security, and healthcare compliance contract are approved.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until AdvancedMD approves Relay and Relay implements the approved read-only Railway broker.
No Hermes tools are callable until AdvancedMD approves Relay and Relay implements the approved read-only Railway broker.

providerSetup.blocker: AdvancedMD offers proprietary Connect APIs with broad CRUD authority and read-only FHIR APIs using SMART OAuth. Access to full documentation and a sandbox requires a signed NDA or Certified API Developer Agreement plus licensing and support fees; production credentials follow a successful integration demonstration. Relay has no agreement, paid license, sandbox, approved appname, demonstrated integration, SMART registration, practice authorization, BAA and HIPAA allocation, minimum-necessary resource map, security acceptance, or production authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Authorized Relay business, legal, privacy, security, healthcare compliance, and product owners must decide whether to fund and execute AdvancedMD's developer program, sign the required agreement and BAA allocation, obtain a sandbox, register the exact SMART-on-FHIR application, and secure written approval for the bounded read-only use case. They must document authorized practices and users, exact FHIR resources and minimized fields, patient or provider consent, purpose limitation, token and endpoint discovery, tenancy, audit, retention, deletion, breach duties, rate limits, disconnect, and production acceptance. Engineering can then implement a fixed-origin Railway SMART broker for only the approved bounded clinical-summary reads. Connect API CRUD, scheduling, prescriptions, clinical changes, billing, claims, payments, messaging, bulk export, raw PHI, and every mutation remain excluded.

evidence.supports: AdvancedMD documents full-CRUD proprietary Connect APIs, a signed developer agreement with licensing and support fees, sandbox access, an integration demonstration before production credentials, and read-only SMART-on-FHIR APIs.

AdvancedMD's developer-license request requires product, specialty, company, and client or office-key details; full documentation requires an NDA or developer agreement and access normally has upfront and monthly costs.
AdvancedMD describes its interoperability suite and broad PM and EHR API surface, while requiring registration for the full technical documentation.
AdvancedMD describes its unified EHR, practice management, patient engagement, billing, revenue-cycle, scheduling, reporting, and clinical workflow product.
